host.description: Host identifier, must match the JSON filename without .json, except files starting with _

detect_env.description: Environment markers used by detect_backend.py to auto-detect this host when --host is omitted

env.description: Map of environment variable name to required value; a value of true means the variable only needs to be set and non-empty

permissions_hints.description: Tool-permission rule strings the host may prompt the user to pre-approve

backend.description: native = host built-in tool; shell = shell command pattern; external_cli = agent-reach/mcporter; public_only = no login-gated access; none = unavailable

tool.description: For backend=native: the host tool name to invoke

invocation.description: For backend=shell: command template with {url} / {query} placeholders

note.description: Behavioral caveats the agent must respect when using this capability
